items.title: Govt panel proposes sweeping changes to airport tariff framework
items.description: The panel concluded that the current tariff regime is too rigid and limits airports' ability to use pricing incentives to attract airlines

items.title: Mahindra to sell truck, bus division to SML Mahindra for Rs 525 crore in commercial vehicle overhaul
items.description: The internal restructuring follows Mahindra's acquisition of SML and is aimed at creating a single commercial vehicle entity with a wider product portfolio and improved operational efficiencies

items.title: 'We can sweat our assets beyond movies': Why PVR INOX isn't relying on blockbusters alone
items.description: Promoter Ajay Bijli is focusing on making the multiplex chain a broader out of home entertainment option with supply of reruns, sports as well as music content.

items.title: Unilever India gets rating upgrades after worst day in six years
items.description: HSBC Holdings Plc, CLSA and BNP Paribas were among the brokerages that raised their recommendations on the stock while maintaining a broadly bullish view on the company’s sales growth.

items.title: Coforge Q1 FY27: Strong start to the year with stellar earnings
items.description: Strong execution, improving margins, and a record deal pipeline reinforce the company’s leadership in IT services growth

items.title: HUL Q1: Growth is balanced, but margin pressure disappoints
items.description: Competitive volume-led core growth, combined with a pivot to high-margin segments, will drive sustained earnings
